causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at washer and faucets and make sure end of drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Oversudsing
remedies: Use less detergent or low sudsing detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Oversudsing"

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to a low-sudsing detergent and follow instructions on package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected
remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.
Top of drain outlet should be less than 8 ft.
(2.5 m) above floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Control is not set properly
remedies: Check water temperature control and adjust.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Control is not set properly"

causes.label: Water supply is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Water supply is improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°–140°F (48°–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "House water heater is not set properly"

symptoms.symptom: Water does not enter washer or enters slowly

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn on both hot and cold faucets fully.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: The washer normally pauses between washing steps
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "The washer normally pauses between washing steps"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls and make sure Cycle knob is pulled out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Door is open
remedies: Close door and pull Cycle knob out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Door is open"

causes.label: Dispenser drawer is open
remedies: Close drawer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Dispenser drawer is open"

causes.label: Motor is overheated
remedies: Washer motor will stop if it becomes overheated.
It will automatically restart after a cool down period of up to 30 minutes (if washer has not been manually turned off).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Motor is overheated"

causes.label: Washer door open
remedies: Make sure door is closed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer door open"

causes.label: Dispenser drawer open
remedies: Close drawer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Dispenser drawer open"

causes.label: Load is too small
remedies: Add one or two similar items to help balance the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Load is too small"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: Make sure washer is level and rests firmly on the floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer is uneven"

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Push the Cycle knob in to stop the washer, open the door and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the door and restart.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: High pitch jet engine sound
remedies: This is normal during the spin cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "High pitch jet engine sound"

causes.label: Squealing sound or hot rubber odor
remedies: Washer is overloaded.
Stop washer and reduce load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Squealing sound or hot rubber odor"

causes.label: Shipping bolts and foam block have not been removed
remedies: See Installation Instructions for directions to remove shipping bolts and foam block.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Shipping bolts and foam block have not been removed"

causes.label: Rattling and clanking caused by foreign objects in tub or pump or metal fasteners hitting tub
remedies: Check drum for foreign objects.
Turn items with metal fasteners inside out.
Call authorized servicer to inspect pump.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Rattling and clanking caused by foreign objects in tub or pump or metal fasteners hitting tub"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Excess wash time may create lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Try a liquid detergent.
Use warmer water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Detergent not dissolving"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Wash drum may be fully loaded with loosely added items.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"
